headline: Bitcoin climbed back above $81,000 after US growth beat forecasts and inflation came in as expected; Coinbase and Strategy report after the US close, and about $11.7B of bitcoin and ether options expire Friday at 15:00 Bangkok.

market.asOf: Read about 16:00 UTC Thu 29 Oct (23:00 Bangkok). The two price sites disagree: CoinGecko had BTC $81,766 (+1.5% in 24 hours), ETH $2,343.65 (+0.5%), SOL $103.13 (+2.0%); CoinMarketCap had BTC $81,123.56 (+0.66%), ETH $2,359.77 (+0.78%), SOL $100.58 (-0.64%), so SOL's 24-hour direction is not settled. Figures below are CoinGecko's. Live prices are at the top of the page.
market.fearGreed: 51, Neutral, on the alternative.me Crypto Fear & Greed Index; 44 out of 100 on CoinMarketCap's CMC Fear and Greed Index (read about 16:00 UTC).

stories.title: Bitcoin climbs back above $81,000 after strong US growth and as-expected inflation data
stories.summary: Bitcoin fell to about $79,600 overnight, then recovered above $81,000 after the 8:30am ET US data and the Wall Street open. The US economy grew faster than forecast in July to September, and September inflation matched expectations.
points: Bitcoin reached $81,547 after the Wall Street open, up from a low of $79,607 after Wednesday's close, per Cointelegraph.
US GDP grew at a 3.4% yearly pace in the third quarter, against 3.2% expected and 2.2% in the second quarter, per the BEA and Fox Business.
September PCE inflation was 3.6% a year (August 3.4%); core PCE, which leaves out food and energy, was 3.1% (August 3.0%). Both matched forecasts, per Fox Business.
Weekly jobless claims were 194,000, below the 199,000 expected in a Reuters poll.
The European Central Bank held its deposit rate at 2.50%, and President Christine Lagarde said she will step down early, on 7 Feb 2027, per Euronews.

sources.label: Cointelegraph: bitcoin reaction to PCE data
Euronews: ECB holds, Lagarde to leave early

stories.title: NYSE owner ICE moves to bring Hyperliquid-style perpetual futures to the US
stories.summary: Intercontinental Exchange, which owns the New York Stock Exchange, will partner with and invest in TradeXYZ to offer perpetual futures built on Hyperliquid's technology, per The Block. The plan still needs regulatory approval.
points: The markets would cover crypto, stocks, stock indices, commodities and currencies, with ICE running the regulated exchange and clearing, per The Block.
Hyperliquid's HYPE token rose about 15% to around $91.21 on the news; its all-time high is $97.96, per The Block (at 10:43am ET).
CFTC staff opened a US path for perpetual futures with an advisory and no-action relief in May, per The Block.

stories.title: Coinbase and Strategy report third-quarter results after the US close tonight
stories.summary: Coinbase and Strategy, which describes itself as the largest corporate holder of bitcoin, both report third-quarter results after the US market closes on Thursday. Analysts expect Coinbase to post a loss.
points: Coinbase's live Q&A is at 2:00pm PT (5:00pm ET, 04:00 Friday Bangkok); Strategy's webinar is at 5:00pm ET, per the companies.
Analysts expect Coinbase to lose $0.23 a share on $1.21B of revenue, per MarketBeat; 24/7 Wall St has a loss of about $0.22 on $1.20B. A year ago it earned $1.44 a share on $1.87B, per MarketBeat.
Strategy shareholders approved daily dividends on its preferred shares with 99.3% in favour; STRC's first daily payment is on 2 Nov, per Decrypt.
Strategy paused bitcoin buying last week and spent $204.9M buying back STRC shares, per Decrypt.

briefs.title: Bitcoin funds take in money for a third day
briefs.summary: US spot bitcoin ETFs took in about $137M on Wed 28 Oct, turning October net positive at +$111M; ether ETFs lost about $21M and are down $1.35B for the month, per Cointelegraph citing SoSoValue. Thursday's figures were not out yet.

briefs.title: About $11B of bitcoin options expire Friday
briefs.summary: $10.86B of bitcoin and $783M of ether options settle on Deribit at 08:00 UTC Friday (15:00 Bangkok); traders are paying more for downside protection than for upside bets, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: HTX agrees to leave the UK
briefs.summary: The Justin Sun-linked exchange stopped UK deposits and sign-ups in a settlement with the FCA, and UK users have 48 hours to withdraw; the settlement is not an admission of wrongdoing, per Decrypt.

briefs.title: Walmart and Eli Lilly object to OKX-ICE tokenized stock trading
briefs.summary: 38 of the 62 companies on the planned 24/7 tokenized US stock venue have now objected, by CoinDesk's count.

briefs.title: Bitcoin Core bug can crash Windows and Mac nodes
briefs.summary: A malicious peer can crash nodes; fixed versions are 29.5, 30.4, 31.2 and 32.1. A crash does not mean stolen funds, per Crypto Briefing.

calendar.event: US Q3 GDP, September PCE inflation and jobless claims
calendar.note: Actual: GDP 3.4% vs 3.2% expected (prior 2.2%); PCE 3.6% a year and core PCE 3.1%, both as expected; jobless claims 194K vs 199K expected, per BEA, Fox Business and Reuters.
Actual: held, deposit rate 2.50%. Lagarde will step down early on 7 Feb 2027, per Euronews.
Coinbase Q&A, Strategy webinar and Amazon call all at 5:00pm ET (04:00 Friday Bangkok), per the companies. Coinbase expected loss $0.23 a share on $1.21B revenue, per MarketBeat.
Rate 1.25%; a 'hawkish hold' is expected, per Yahoo Finance. Release time not confirmed this run.

At 08:00 UTC. About $10.9B of bitcoin options with 'max pain' at $78,000, and about $776M of ether options with max pain at $2,500, per KuCoin and Phemex citing Deribit. Max pain is not a price target.

calendar.event: US Employment Cost Index (Q3); Chicago PMI at 9:45am ET
calendar.note: ECI expected +0.8% for the quarter, prior +0.9%. Chicago PMI expected 55.8, prior 58.8, per TradingCharts.

calendar.note: See the unlock table on this page for sizes, dates and confidence. US clocks go back one hour on Sun 1 Nov: from then, Bangkok is ET+12.

calendar.note: A rise to 4.85% is expected, per investingLive.

calendar.note: First polls close 6pm ET (06:00 Wednesday Bangkok), per Rio Times. JOLTS prior 7.1M, per BLS.

calendar.event: Circle and Riot earnings calls; ADP jobs (8:15am ET); ISM services (10:00am ET)
calendar.note: Call times per the companies. ADP prior +90K, per ADP; ISM services prior 54.9.

Bank Rate 3.75%; a rise to 4% is a live possibility, per Cambridge Currencies. Next: US October jobs report Fri 6 Nov 8:30am ET (20:30 Bangkok), per BLS; the next Fed decision is Wed 9 Dec, per the Federal Reserve.
